newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Acindar gets hold rating.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Acindar gets hold rating.

text.p: Argentina's Banco Comafi said Tuesday it gave steelmaker Acindar a "hold" recommendation.

Acindar got a "financial respite" after issuing $100 million in corporate bonds in February, analysts Norberto Couto and Esteban Marx wrote in a research report. Acindar must pay about $45 million in interest in its fiscal year ending June 30.
A modernization program allowed it to trim sales costs five percent compared with the year ended June 30, 1996.
With 60 percent of Argentina's domestic market share, Acindar is the main vendor of non-flat iron, they said.

On the negative side, they underlined the high debt level, its dependence on Brazilian raw material imports in disadvantageous conditions vis a vis Brazilian firms and a lower profit margin for steelmakers as a consequence of a progressive tariffs cut in the customs union Mercosur formed by Argentina, Brazil, Uruguay and Paraguay.
